outcomes.name: iADRS (integrated Alzheimer’s Disease Rating Scale) change from baseline at Week 76
outcomes.quote: Study AACI showed that the donanemab arm compared to the placebo arm had statistically significantly less decline at Week 76 as measured by iADRS: intermediate tau population (3.3; 95% CI 1.9, 4.6; p < 0.001); overall population (2.9; 95% CI 1.5, 4.3; p < 0.001).
outcomes.prespecification_evidence: A natural cubic spline analysis with 2 degrees of freedom was pre-specified to assess the difference between treatment groups.

outcomes.name: CDR-SB (Clinical Dementia Rating Scale – Sum of Boxes) change from baseline at Week 76
outcomes.quote: The donanemab arm compared to the placebo arm had statistically significantly less decline at Week 76 as measured by the secondary endpoint CDR-SB: intermediate tau population (-0.7; 95% CI -1.0, -0.4; p < 0.001); overall population (-0.7; 95% CI -1.0, -0.5; p < 0.001).

The hazard ratio (HR) in the intermediate tau population was 0.6 (95% CI 0.5, 0.8; p-value < 0.001) and the overall population was 0.6 (95% CI 0.5, 0.8; p-value < 0.001)

outcomes.name: Amyloid centiloid (CL) change from baseline at Week 76
outcomes.quote: At Week 76, the donanemab arm compared to the placebo arm had statistically significantly more amyloid plaque reduction as measured by amyloid PET (centiloid units). The difference in adjusted mean change from baseline in amyloid centiloids in the intermediate tau population was -88.2 (95% CI -91.2, -85.2; p < 0.0001) and the overall population was -86.4 (95% CI -88.9, -83.9; p < 0.0001)

disagreements.question: Primary endpoint selection
disagreements.position: The Division had not agreed to iADRS as the primary endpoint and had advised instead CDR-SB (Clinical Dementia Rating Scale – Sum of Boxes) as one of the alternatives.
disagreements.quote: The Division had not agreed to iADRS as the primary endpoint and had advised instead CDR-SB (Clinical Dementia Rating Scale – Sum of Boxes) as one of the alternatives.

disagreements.question: Primary statistical analysis model
disagreements.position: MMRM had typically been used in AD studies, including study AACG, as the primary analysis model. However, for study AACI, Sponsor proposed natural cubic splines with 2 degrees of freedom (NCS2) based on analyses that showed NCS2 attaining higher statistical power compared to MMRM. After Sponsor responded to the Division’s concerns about bias and Type I error inflation, the Division agreed to the NCS2 model as the primary analysis model.

multiplicity.quote: A prespecified hypothesis testing plan employed Bretz’s graphical approach (Bretz et al. 2009, 2011) to provide control of the study-wise Type I error rate for the primary and key secondary hypotheses at 2-sided level α=0.05.

risk_of_bias.judgement: High missing data rates can result in efficacy and safety estimates that are unreliable for decision making.
risk_of_bias.quote: Study discontinuation was high with the donanemab arm having a higher rate compared to the placebo arm (27% vs. 20%). The tipping point analysis to assess sensitivity of the CDR-SB primary analysis to missing data assumptions showed that the results in both the intermediate tau and overall population were not statistically significant near the delta pair (0, 0.5), where 0.5 is the minimum within-subject scale increment change.

risk_of_bias.judgement: Ignoring deaths, a negative outcome, could bias the primary analysis result for these endpoints.
risk_of_bias.quote: Another issue was the handling of death, which resulted in missing data, in the primary analysis of clinical endpoints. Although Sponsor was advised to account for death in the primary efficacy analysis, Sponsor instead assumed death was not informative and treated measurements after death as being missing; thereby, ignoring the severity of death in a patient’s disease trajectory.
